name: meditrack-monorepo
description: MediTrack Clinic Appointment & AI Symptom Triage System

scripts.dev:server: cd server && (pnpm run dev || npm run dev)
scripts.dev:client: cd client && (pnpm run dev || npm run dev)
scripts.install:all: cd server && (pnpm install || npm install) && cd ../client && (pnpm install || npm install)
scripts.build:server: cd server && (pnpm run build || npm run build)
scripts.build:client: cd client && (pnpm run build || npm run build)
